synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO market notice: City West transformer trip reported in SA1 on 2026-07-30
summary: The notice reports that during restoration the City West transformer and an associated 275 kV circuit breaker tripped [c1].
The notice states AEMO did not instruct load shedding and has not been advised of any disconnection of bulk electrical load [c1].
The notice states that "The cause of this non credible contingency event is not known at this stage." [c1]

possible_explanations.statement: The transformer or its protection equipment may have operated abnormally during restoration, causing the trip (see [c1]).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review City West protection relay event logs, SCADA sequence-of-events, and fault records for the restoration interval; compare with a post-event AEMO incident report or equipment owner report.

possible_explanations.statement: A switching or procedural issue during the restoration might have contributed to the trip, as reported in the notice (see [c1]).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain restoration work records, switchyard switching logs, and operator communications; inspect site maintenance and operational procedures and any follow-up AEMO or participant correspondence.

citations.quote: At 1140 hrs, the City West 275/66 kV transformer T_1 and the 275 kV circuit breaker 6675 tripped during restoration of City West 275/66 kV transformer T_2.
citations.supports: Reports that the City West transformer and a 275 kV circuit breaker tripped during restoration.

uncertainties: The notice explicitly states "The cause of this non credible contingency event is not known at this stage." [c1]
The notice reports AEMO did not instruct load shedding and that AEMO had not been advised of any disconnection of bulk electrical load, leaving uncertainty about any local customer impacts [c1].
missing_evidence: Protection relay event logs and fault records for City West transformer T_1 and circuit breaker 6675 for the restoration interval.
SCADA sequence-of-events and breaker/tranformer status telemetry for the interval referenced in the notice.
Any AEMO incident report, participant post-event report, or follow-up market notice providing root-cause analysis or remedial actions.
